description: This file extends the ProcessInfo class with additional properties and methods to determine runtime environments such as preview mode, nix mode, and test execution state, using environment variables, app bundle info, and UserDefaults.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Extended with computed properties and static methods to detect environment and runtime modes.

methods.name: isPreview
methods.description: Determines if the app is running in Xcode preview mode by checking the environment variable 'XCODE_RUNNING_FOR_PREVIEWS'.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: Determines if the app is running in Nix mode based on environment variables, UserDefaults, and whether it is a bundle app.

methods.name: isNixMode
methods.description: Checks whether the current environment is in Nix mode by invoking resolveNixMode with current condition context.

methods.name: isRunningTests
methods.description: Detects if the app is currently executing unit tests by inspecting loaded bundles and environment variables.
